name: Publish Blog Post
description: Guides the user through the complete blog post creation pipeline from research and briefing through writing, SEO optimization, proofreading, and scheduling for publication. Use when the user wants to publish a blog post end-to-end, needs a structured content pipeline, or wants to go from topic idea to published article with quality gates at each stage. Do NOT use for writing a blog post without a publishing workflow (use blog-post-writing), for SEO-only optimization (use seo-blog-post), or for building an ongoing content calendar (use create-content-calendar).
